name: render-compiled-svg
title: Render prepared VizIR with exact text resources
description: Render a local persisted vizir-compiled-mir/1 document with matching MIR/HIR 0.4, canonical theme, exact measured font resources and optional supported wrapping to outlined SVG plus a mandatory path-free fidelity receipt; replay the saved context without importing data or changing layout policy.

input.description: Read the complete vizir-compiled-mir/1 JSON envelope from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 32 MiB.

text_profile.description: Read the exact source text profile from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 256 KiB, and require typed equality with persisted context.text.

text_layout.description: Read the optional exact source wrapping policy from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 256 KiB, and require typed equality with persisted context.text_layout.

font_1.description: Read the first explicitly supplied font file from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 32 MiB.

font_2.description: Read the optional second explicitly supplied font file from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 32 MiB.

font_3.description: Read the optional third explicitly supplied font file from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 32 MiB.

input.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit input input with lowercase SHA-256.

text_profile.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit text_profile input with lowercase SHA-256.

text_layout.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit text_layout input with lowercase SHA-256.

font_1.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit font_1 input with lowercase SHA-256.

font_2.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit font_2 input with lowercase SHA-256.

font_3.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit font_3 input with lowercase SHA-256.

resource_pins.description: Bind each supplied input-file role to its expected SHA-256, with exactly the same role set and no resource paths.

output.description: Write the primary outlined SVG to this explicit .svg destination, which the Hub may stage before publication.

receipt.description: Write the mandatory path-free vizir.render-receipt/v1 JSON containing primary artifact identity, exact input hashes, context, capability decisions and loss records.

path.description: Locate the primary SVG artifact published by the Hub.

kind.description: Identify the verified primary SVG artifact encoding.

determinism.notes: Deterministic replay is scoped to the same provider build, exact compiled input and resource bytes; this profile makes no cross-build, cross-platform or cross-provider byte/pixel parity promise.
